name: W28 Morning Flow — Hollow Hold, Frog + Saddle
description:
The daily 15-minute opener for a short, sleep-deprived week. Week 27 established that dead bugs do not land, so the core slot is a **hollow-body hold**. **Frog stretch returns deliberately** for the adductors, and **saddle pose stays** for quads and hip flexors. The protective anchors remain: scorpion, lizard, cossack, the push-up greasing set, and the day-specific rehab cluster.

**Use the readiness screen, not the calendar, to choose the dose.** If cossacks and lizard feel open, run the full flow. If they feel sticky, keep the anchors and skip one work-block movement. Five clean minutes still counts.

sets.name: ☀️ Through the Day — Small and Often (Not Now)

exercises.notes: Easy breathing and heels down. This is a separate daily reminder, not part of the morning sequence.
Thirty seconds per side; use a fingertip support if sleep has balance feeling off.
Heel stays down; knee tracks over the toes.
Light band, slow return.
Move continuously between the shapes; do not settle into a long hold yet.
Forty-five seconds per side, following the hand with the eyes.
Small controlled rotation; ribs stay stacked over the pelvis.

sets.name: Work Block — Warm Without Fatigue (~5 min)

exercises.reps: one easy set, 2-3 reps in reserve
exercises.notes: Greasing set only. Pack the shoulders down; stop well before failure.
Lower back pressed into the floor. Bend the knees if needed; keep the position honest. This replaces the dead bug, which did not land in Week 27.
Pause briefly at the top without arching the low back.
Feet wide, hips quiet. Skip this movement on the exhausted five-minute version.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Hip + Spine Arc (~7 min)

exercises.notes: Alternate sides slowly; let the upper back rotate.
Forty-five seconds per side. This and cossacks are the readiness read.
Move only through the range that stays controlled; notice stiffness rather than forcing depth.
Deliberately back for Week 28. Knees wide, shins parallel, and ease the hips back; let the adductors open without forcing the knees.
Keep from Week 27. Lean back only as far as the knees and low back stay comfortable; use the hands for support.
Finish here; let the low back and hips settle.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)

exercises.notes: Push add-on: thirty seconds per side at mid elbow height.
Push add-on: thumbs up, neck long, lower traps doing the work.
Push add-on: arms stay straight while the shoulder blades glide.
Pull add-on: easy decompression before loaded pulling.
Pull add-on: initiate by packing down, not bending the elbows.
Pull or KB add-on: light and controlled.
KB add-on: ribs down and range limited to what stays smooth.
Legs add-on: thirty seconds per side for the lateral chain.
Legs add-on: thirty seconds per side with slow breathing.

tips: The cossacks and lizard are the readiness screen; trust the movement quality over the sleep score.
The push-up set is greasing, never a max effort.
Full flow when able, ten minutes when tired, anchors only when exhausted. Short still counts.
